table_mode: All LLD-03 authoritative tables use SQLite STRICT mode and LLD-01 FK/index/protection verification.

tables.name: service_requests
columns: service_request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
official_sr_no TEXT UNIQUE
local_sr_no TEXT UNIQUE
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
updated_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(updated_at_utc>=created_at_utc)
CHECK(official_sr_no IS NOT NULL OR local_sr_no IS NOT NULL)
CHECK(official_sr_no IS NULL OR (length(official_sr_no)=8 AND official_sr_no NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'))
CHECK(local_sr_no IS NULL OR (length(local_sr_no)=12 AND substr(local_sr_no,1,4)='LSR-' AND substr(local_sr_no,5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'))
rules: service_request_id is immutable UUIDv4 relational identity
manual SR without official identity receives non-reusable LSR sequence
later official assignment preserves service_request_id and local_sr_no
an SR created directly with official identity need not fabricate a local_sr_no
official_sr_no uniqueness is business uniqueness, never relational identity
terminal/current source projections are separate accepted facts and never cause replacement entity creation

tables.name: rfcs
columns: rfc_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
rfc_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(rfc_no)=16 AND substr(rfc_no,1,2)='NC' AND substr(rfc_no,3) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
customer_org_id TEXT REFERENCES customer_organizations(customer_org_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
local_archive_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(local_archive_state IN ('active','archived'))
external_created_at_utc INTEGER CHECK(external_created_at_utc IS NULL OR external_created_at_utc>=0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
updated_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(updated_at_utc>=created_at_utc)
rules: rfc_id is immutable SOMA identity; exact NC+14 is unique business identity
manual/provisional/source-adopted RFCs with the same exact rfc_no are one entity
there is no persisted master/subordinate/standalone role flag
customer_org_id is zero-or-one current canonical Customer and cannot be inferred from Infrastructure
local_archive_state is reversible SOMA-local presentation state and is independent from provider lifecycle/status
external_created_at_utc remains nullable and distinct from SOMA created_at_utc/import/file chronology
there is no mutable ever_imported/adopted boolean; accepted source provenance is derived from source-observation history owned with reconciliation

tables.name: sr_working_notes
columns: working_note_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
service_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
created_by_local_user_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles(local_user_profile_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
body_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(body_text)>0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
updated_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(updated_at_utc>=created_at_utc)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: SOMA-owned; imports cannot overwrite/delete
creating Local User Profile identity is captured explicitly and remains immutable
edit/remove is explicit audited operator action
original created_at_utc is immutable

tables.name: rfc_working_notes
columns: working_note_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
created_by_local_user_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles(local_user_profile_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
body_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(body_text)>0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
updated_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(updated_at_utc>=created_at_utc)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: SOMA-owned; imports cannot overwrite/delete
creating Local User Profile identity is captured explicitly and remains immutable
edit/remove is explicit audited operator action
original created_at_utc is immutable

index_rules: service_requests.official_sr_no and service_requests.local_sr_no rely on their existing UNIQUE indexes for exact lookup; redundant duplicate indexes are forbidden by the LLD-01 schema rule
protection: note-table BEFORE UPDATE rejects working_note_id/owner/created_by_local_user_profile_id/created_at_utc changes; only body_text/revision/updated_at_utc may change through governed command
note-table BEFORE DELETE is permitted only through explicit RemoveWorkingNote command path whose prior body/time/creator are included in required audit; repositories expose no generic delete
deferred_in_this_file: current source-owned SR/RFC field projection tables and accepted observation lineage
RFC hierarchy/relationship history tables defined in schema/relationships.json
narrow hard-delete guards defined by command/algorithm contracts
